answer: Cap new identities per epoch and auction the slots: only a fixed number of registrations open each epoch, and each slot goes to the highest bidder, with the fee burned. A sybil farmer chasing a thousand clones must outbid honest newcomers a thousand times, so the cost of an army rises with demand instead of staying near zero. A hollow registry that admits everyone for free invites a zephyr of fake faces; a crystal-clear auction makes each extra identity carry a real, public price, and honest agents pay once and keep working.
